item: A finished encrypt, diagnostics bundle or restore no longer answers an error when the collection loop's thread cannot be restarted afterwards
summary: When the process could not create the scheduler loop's thread, the resume that ends every exclusive operation raised out of the operation's own finally: a finished POST /api/system/encrypt-db answered 500 (the store was encrypted and the snapshot was on disk, but the response reporting both was lost) and a finished GET /api/diagnostics/all answered 500 after building the whole bundle. The call is now guarded in resume_after_exclusive_operation (not inside the retry loop, R163): a WARNING with the exception class only, then the existing pending-resume watcher takes over. Interrupts are not swallowed and the hold is still released. Red on main (3 of 5 new tests); three mutants each turn a test red. Measured by WAL with an injected refusal; not seen in the field.
